isla.title: Tortuga Island tour from Tambor
isla.p1: We leave Tambor by boat for Tortuga Island, one of the most beautiful beaches in the Gulf of Nicoya: white sand, palm trees and turquoise water.
isla.li3: Free time on the beach to swim and relax
isla.li5: With some luck, dolphins along the way
isla.bring: Swimsuit, towel, sunscreen, water and a good mood.
isla.note: Price, departure time and details: message us and we will reply on WhatsApp.

faq.title: Questions about our Tambor tours
faq.q1: Where does the Tortuga Island tour leave from?
faq.a1: It leaves by boat from Tambor, on the Nicoya Peninsula. When you book we confirm the exact meeting point.
faq.q2: What does the Tortuga Island tour include?
faq.a2: A boat ride along the coast, snorkeling in clear water, free time on the beach and fresh fruit (pineapple and watermelon).
faq.q3: How do I book a tour in Tambor?
faq.a3: Message us on WhatsApp with the tour, the date and how many people are coming. We confirm availability, price and meeting point.
